name: Morph
doc: Morph (enemy attack 53, Jelleye's): two ring meshes at the caster's point, turning and fading in and out, sparkles appearing at random bones of the caster, the caster hidden and redrawn with a cycling colour over its faces near its point; the sound at the caster (its code applies no action result). Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag172_morph.cpp) run on the program's memory (its sparkles, the rings' radii and vertex buffers, its queues and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The director's ticks: the caster's point (tick 0), the rings, the sparkles, the sound at the caster, the tinted caster, the end; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Rings
parts.doc: Two ring meshes at the caster's point through the shadow camera, turning (one faster), fading in and out

parts.title: Sparkles
parts.doc: Still sparkles appearing at random bones of the caster, each playing its flipbook once

parts.title: Tinted caster
parts.doc: The caster hidden and redrawn with a cycling colour over its faces near its point, from black and back
